title: Certify the inverse 1-norm of #4319's normalized Gaussian Schur section: 2.8138, against the lemma's 3938 ceiling (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/gaussian-section-inverse-norms/`. It answers the open question of #4319 (jwr404): what is the induced **1-norm** of the inverse of the normalized `p = 19` Gaussian Schur section on survivors `0, 1, 2, 7, 8, 9`? It also rechecks #4319's infinity-norm bracket by a different route.

**Claim type: a certified finite computation on one section. No new κ.** This is not an all-size inverse bound.

The 1-norm matters because #4100's `INVERSE-CONDITIONING.md` bounds the 2-norm by `√(‖·‖₁ ‖·‖_∞)`. Its 1-norm ceiling `1/δ + 2bρ/δ²` is the large factor. At #4317's tight gap it is 3938.

## Result

Every value is certified with exact rationals, to within `7·10⁻⁸⁷`.

| Norm of `N⁻¹` | Value | Ceiling (#4317) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| infinity, attained at row 0 | `3.600635404331…` | 27 |
| 1, attained at column 2 | `2.813821688397…` | 3938 |
| 2 | in `[1.6265, 3.1830]` | 321 |

- **#4319's bracket holds:** `18/5 < ‖N⁻¹‖_∞ < 361/100`.
- **The 1-norm is about 1/1400 of the lemma's ceiling.** It is also below the infinity norm.
- **The same holds on the unsectioned 10-vertex path:** `‖A⁻¹‖₁ = 4.3868`, against `‖A⁻¹‖_∞ = 6.0623`.

**Control.** The principal restriction `A_KK`, which skips the interior elimination and so the filled 2→7 entry, has inverse infinity norm below 3. It misses #4319's bracket.

## Independence

The verifier imports nothing from #4319.

- **Entries.** It builds the entries from `GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md`'s original form, `exp(−a[(ρh + β_i)² − β_{i+h}²])`, and checks exactly that this equals the gauge form #4319 uses.
- **No Schur complement.** By the quotient identity, `N⁻¹ = (A⁻¹)_KK · diag(S)`.
- **Error control.** It inverts the rational midpoint exactly and covers the entry radii with one perturbation bound, in place of interval elimination.
- **Enclosures.** π (Machin) and `exp` (halving, Taylor and outward squaring) are its own.

## Evidence

The verifier uses only the standard library and runs in about 6 seconds. The three notes it reads are on main, pinned by SHA256, with phrase checks.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-section-inverse-norms --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-section-inverse-norms
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/gaussian-section-inverse-norms outcome=completed
```

Head: `2d2ea7bd2ae310a50cf29d0a6fe989b4336b891b`.

## Not covered

- Other sections, primes and bandwidths.
- `GAUSSIAN.md`'s all-size row-gap claim.
- Whether #4100's callers need this section's true 2-norm or only the lemma's ceiling.

## Task and overlap

- Card: `uniform-transfer-audit` (precision/conditioning obligation of #4100), refined, priority revision 7.
- Base: canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`.
- No PR or discussion had taken #4319's open question.

The kernel and the lemma are #4100's (`GAUSSIAN.md`, `INVERSE-CONDITIONING.md` and the vendored `GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md`).
